audience: HR teams that check absences, personnel data and job postings in HR WORKS

useCases.title: See who is absent in a period
useCases.text: List the absences of persons in a date interval of one year at most. Read each page with nextPage.

useCases.title: Find a person and their organization unit
useCases.text: List persons grouped by organization unit, then read the base data of one person by identifier.

useCases.title: Track open job postings
useCases.text: List the job postings, and read each posting's offers with publication and validity dates.

useCases.title: Review applications for a posting
useCases.text: List the job applications for given posts and status values. Each page holds 50 applications.
